notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0a6f8cfb2f53a17a5522a06fb00344b66c68617.png"][/img] Overview[/h1][h3]❖ v2.0.7.0[/h3][p]The first two items on our content roadmap (Balancing + Bug Fixes, and game optimizations) have been completed.  While our efforts aren't done, we've made considerable enough progress in both departments that we are now comfortable moving forward.[/p][p][i]*For details about the roadmap, check out our Content Roadmap post:[/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2538000/announcements/detail/519723193024381528"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]It's been a while since we've made any major patches, so we're going to take this opportunity to cover not only Season 2 changes, but list changes previously made in Season 1 that were never officially documented.  [i]First let's cover an upcoming event...[/i][/p][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/3777aee3888a6865d0717bb8e79a09f05cc47a92.png"][/img]Events[/h1][h2]❖ Dojo Masters World Warrior Tournament[/h2][p]  [b]September 20th (8:00pm EST / 5:00pm PST)[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/3e810308578c38c2596c1e7f09f416d86695717f.png"][/img][/p][h3][i][b]Tournament Match Rules:[/b][/i][/h3][list][*][p]Matches will be a first-to-5, with Grand Finals being a first-to-10.[/p][/*][*][p]Once per set, upon losing a match, you are allowed to change your Martial Art.[/p][/*][/list][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"][/img] [url="https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/RsIgX2MAdM#/signup/2qyrnbg51gu" style="button" buttoncolor="#3071bb"]Click Here To Sign Up For The Tournament[/url][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Watch The Tournament:[/b][/h3][p][b]  Twitch[/b] [dynamiclink src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/e0b9bddfd2f416cf65784c43d74cb692046b20b2.png"][/img] General Changes[/h1][h2]❖ New Additions[/h2][p]• 4 New Mission Mode missions have been added (Additional missions added each week)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4cfe6fd2e62b6407db484245159d940dff3d5784.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Revamped cleaner Stamina Bar design when Stamina exceeds 6 bars.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/df3f6ee730aabf650d2892bd28a80dc62602bf4f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Optimizations[/h2][list][*][p]Main Menu performance has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall gameplay performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements in regards to in-game Statistics leading to faster game/menu transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to Steam Achievement/Stats checking performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Replays Mode been reworked to be more optimized (Less RAM usage) and less buggy.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Hitstop interactions in Free-For-All styled matches to scale down for the sake of responsiveness.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]❖ General Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a major desync that could occur when getting a Knockdown when playing online.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for DLC Character Mastery Achievements resetting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix to Netcode to better prevent unintentional disconnects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a minor bug that caused players to "not exist" for a single frame on Victory/Taunt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to Training Mode FrameData Timeline and Dummy Behaviors to be more consistent/accurate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a local Free-For-All displaying the wrong character icons at the Results screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a minor visual bug involving side-preference settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Wifi/Ethernet Indicators now display properly (Was previously flipped).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Mission Mode loading errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause Mission Mode objects to spawn in other modes unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock when returning to certain menus after playing Co-op Survival Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Crash/softlock that could occur when leaving the Glossary Menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f29616f439d48d83a5dfe196f4c118fc387a7c98.png"][/img]Balance Changes[/h1][h2]❖ System[/h2][p]• Universally, we've gone through with a fine comb to improve the general readability of gameplay.[/p][p] ♦ Most interactions now cause much longer Hitstop (Even more-so on Counter-Hit).[/p][p] ♦ Input Buffers have been tweaked to help certain actions flow a bit more comfortably.[/p][p] ♦ More VFX, SE, and Feed Text have been added to various interactions to better convey what has occurred.[/p][p] ♦ Add pushboxes to most attacks and actions to better prevent awkward player overlapping that could make certain interactions hard to visually parse in some cases.[/p][p]• Removed a Parry/Guard option-select performed by pressing \[FWD]+\[BWD] simultaneously:[/p][p] ♦ Parry now locks itself out for 3 Frames when pressing \[BWD] in neutral.[/p][p] ♦ Parry now locks itself out for 7 Frames when pressing \[BWD] while Parry Attempt is Active.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Shotokan Karate[/h2][p]• Retooled Super Uppercut to be more fair and reliable to execute across all input types.[/p][p]• Super Uppercut now has a "Perfect" variant which occurs when you execute the attack perfectly (Just Frame) with \[FWD]+\[Punch] pressed at the exact same time.[/p][p] ♦ This variant has different knockback properties and deals additional base and chip Damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/174847925e0d54408162195e316c13c94ea2e8ba.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Power Strike now has a "Perfect" variant which occurs when you release the punch at the earliest possible point when reaching max charge.[/p][p] ♦ This variant has different knockback properties and deals additional base and chip Damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/955faf51820b8f198c6a1b34b8a5f492df68489a.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Fixed a bug that could lead to Shotokan Karate sliding indefinitely when getting Hurt while crouching.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Muay Thai[/h2][p]• BWD Walk movement speed has been increased.[/p][p]• Neutral Jab can now combo into Forward Jab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/6168b4bad0f88b762c0cfa332a32b99d2839daf1.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Neutral Kick now aggressively pushes players back.[/p][p]• Forward Kick Knockback has been adjusted to not sent air Targets downward.[/p][p]• Knee Strike has slightly increased recovery on whiff.[/p][p]• Knee Strike has increased recovery when Blocked.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/6b1de99027fb213f630ecc31c3ea0facfee2729d.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Clinch Pummel nudge-velocity now increases in strength with each successive pummel.[/p][p]• Muay Thai is now at advantage if a Grab Release occurs during Clinch.[/p][p]• Fixed an oversight that caused Muay Thai's Pummel directions to be randomized.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that prevented Muay Thai's Launch Protection from activating against Taekwondo's Double Kicks.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Kendo[/h2][p]• Stab now reliably pushes players back (Weakened at tip).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f11aacf72341cc50fbeac6c1e794be7d7492cb69.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Stab now carries a bit of momentum.[/p][p]• Stab can no longer Cancel into itself.[/p][p]• Knockback of Late Death Blow (Launcher) has been readjusted.[/p][p]• Knockback of Auto Combo's 3rd hit has been readjusted.[/p][p]• Kendo now has a Counter-Hit state that occurs when they are interrupted during recovery of Perfect Death Blow.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/30d0b87bcc35d79ed0b60335553e7dc146c8a68a.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Kendo can now more reliably Block during recovery of a Dash/Run.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that allowed Targets to parry the second hit of Kendo's Auto Combo while in Hitstun.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that would cause Kendo's Early Death Blow to softlock the Target in the air.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that prevented Kendo's Reversal Counter Slash from occurring and instead Knocked them down.[/p][p]• All Weapon Attacks now count as both Punch+Kick Type Attacks.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Taekwondo[/h2][p]• Feint Charges reworked slightly to level down when you perform the wrong action instead of completely clearing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/2e311706899f1b16936f924487f41e540f1af755.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Low Kick into High Kick now more reliably combos.[/p][p]• High Kick can now loop back into Low Kick more comfortably.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/69ecbc268d993387cbc94f7a125280ec2924da75.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Spinning High Kick can now cancel into High Kick.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/a9d0dcee2ff97589622279f8cc34d47c7f4b4079.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Tornado Kick is now slower on startup, but much safer when on Block.[/p][p]• Double Kicks now has laggier landing lag On Blocked.[/p][p]• Jump Kick is now much more punishable on Whiff and on Block.[/p][p]• Fly Kick now has a lingering Guard-Only Hitbox.  This Hitbox does not deal CHIP.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/31005620bae116ae86a1e541c49e404d19e0f4a4.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Roll can now consistently slip past Sumo's Charge Tackle.[/p][p]• Reworked timing of certain animations to visually flow better (-appear smoother) on screen.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Boxing[/h2][p]• After getting Parried, Boxing's Spin Dash is the Yellow variant.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/c15f3a4e1565fb1e3fef6af1fbec5b40d81da99e.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Hook now properly pushes out of targets (Preventing awkward visual overlaps).[/p][p]• Spin Dashes now consistently slip past Sumo's Charge Tackle.[/p][p]• Spin Dash charged Strong Attacks now only deal -1/2 Damage to airborne Targets instead of 1.[/p][p]• Fixed some scripting oversights in Boxing's Shuffle that would lead to a faster than normal Shuffle.[/p][p]• Fixed a VFX issue with Boxing's Shuffle[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Krav Maga[/h2][p]• Weak and Strong Counters Attacks/Grab attempts can now be canceled into Charge Attacks on Whiff.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4e10cd6665b1565ada31bcad13b5ae96fccf861a.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Krav Maga now takes increased Hitstop and Hitstun if they guess the wrong Punch/Kick response.[/p][p]• Total Takedown Break Points now reduce with each consecutive Total Takedown minigame that occurs.[/p][p]• Reworked Krav Maga's Movement to be generally snappier/responsive, but also scale with Charge Level.[/p][p]• Grabbing the Target from behind will initiate a new "Back Stab" behavior that forces the Target into NoTech.[/p][p] - If the Target is Weakened, the grab becomes Unbreakable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/d69bb0a8eeed016e04db0c17faf60fc6039b30ce.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Combat Roll can now consistently slip past Sumo's Charge Tackle.[/p][p]• Combat Roll charge time now reduces the higher your Charge Level.[/p][p]• Weak Kick Counter now always counts as a Low Attack.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/12b14fc4dc00b1660bf0dee178bf8935085c5c60.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Weak Kick Counter can now properly interrupt Sumo's Charge Tackle.[/p][p]• Weak Punch/Kick now deal more knockback and less Hitstun when hitting a Target who is already in Hitstun.[/p][p]• Combination Strikes now more reliably hits airborne Targets after Counters.[/p][p]• Combination Strikes is now a True Combo if the first punch hits a Target who is in Hitstun.[/p][p]• FWD Dash can now be buffered out of Hitstun and Blockstun.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that prevented Krav Maga from Blocking during their Landing animation.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Sumo[/h2][p]• White Sumo Shove now deals -1/2 Damage on Counter-Hit.[/p][p]• Sumo Shove can now properly counter-hit Targets, with Yellow and Red Sweat variants placing them into a unique delayed air stalled state.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/d392fe190c35e883461a3b3d96de8e5734530fa5.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Sumo Shove Weak Armor property is now removed if the attack is Blocked.[/p][p]• Sumo Takedown's startup is now very briefly susceptible to getting interrupted by Low Attacks.[/p][p]• Grab now auto-counter-hits airborne Targets, preventing them from Breaking the Grab.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/cb577e1e6c247926e10c9eeb4f9613dc1a24e749.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Grab Fakeout can now Juggle Airborne Targets who are in Hitstun.[/p][p]• Performing a Grab Break now briefly freezes the one who grabbed you (placing Sumo at a slight advantage).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/842dac729abbcc9c2e9557b7ff42ee5b2e2752a8.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Fixed a bug that would lead to Sumo getting Downed while airborne after being thrown.[/p][p]• Fixed an edge case where Sumo's Sumo Power Sweat Level Color didn't match the respective Sumo Shove strength.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Kyokushin Karate[/h2][p]• Kyokushin Karate is now more easily punishable if they get Parried.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/44c4ef2ed31ffc7819ef6edbcf49c266b666c900.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Triangle Kick Hurtbox has been reworked.  It's not less likely to be grabbed or hurt during startup.[/p][p]• Controlled Breathing OnHit healing now fully stops once you reach Combination 4 until you return to 0.[/p][p]• Controlled Breathing passive healing now goes on cooldown for half a second when Grabbed/Thrown.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that allowed Kyokushin Karate to Block immediately after/while being Thrown.[/p][p]• Fixed an oversight that allowed Zenshin Armor Hitstop to occur to opponent when Zenshin was interrupted by a Strong Attack.[/p][p][/p][h2]❖ Capoeira[/h2][p]• Idle Ginga is now slower while Capoeira is Weakened.[/p][p]• Fixed a few instances of Capoeira returning to the wrong Ginga Stance post-action.[/p][p]• Improvements to Capoeira's Rhythm Strike VFX to be more in-style with the game's visuals.[/p][p]• Capoeira now has subtle VFX and SE when reaching Full Ginga.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f0912ef7a18e3685790bbc92c2f14eda80019146.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Capoeira can now cancel FWD Step into BWD Hop (And vise-versa) sooner.[/p][p]• Capoeira's Low Profile actions now more reliably ignore most opponent pushboxes.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that unintentionally gave Capoeira's Low Dodge an upper body Hurtbox when on the Left-Ginga.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/a8b0e5cf0360c292af8d20b36be318d079106ac3.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Push Kick now hits slight further forward against Ground Targets.[/p][p]• Push Kick now starts up faster when performed after a Front cartwheel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/531db28ff51a9da80d25a88c5a2bfbb32cc4a2a5.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Capoeira's Push Kick now has new VFX to better sell the impact.[/p][p]• Compass Kick has been made more low profile on startup.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/985e0c273e328119fd4a845cd57b41fdd56db276.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Crescent Kick is now more low profile on startup.[/p][p]• Capoeira's Compass and Crescent Kicks now ignore most pushboxes on startup.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that prevented Capoeira from Blocking after being Hurt.[/p][p]• Capoeira now has additional VFX to better convey their Blocking Penalty.[/p][p]• Capoeira now takes additional Knockback when Blocking a Low Attack.[/p][p] ♦ This was done to bring it a bit more inline with Blocking High Attacks and to improve readability.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f6305e40ed926e446822f297393f4de7ed4d236c.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Capoeira now clears their Hurt and Block Penalties when Teching, when Grabbed, when Escaping a Grab, or having their Grab Broken.[/p][p]• Capoeira now properly transitions into the Airborne Grab Escape animation when escaping a grab while airborne.[/p][p]• Addressed an oversight that lead Capoeira to having the wrong amount of Hitstun/Blockstun when Hurt/Blocking.[/p][p]• IF Capoeira is standing-combo'd for 3 hits, they when now "Topple" off their feet to prevent infinites.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/02d61fc8a3b619f9ae660436634b4808255431fc.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Fixed a bug that would cause Capoeira to briefly gain additional hurtboxes when attacks were interrupted.[/p][p]• Added a Pushbox to Capoeira's Arm(s) during the startup of Special Kicks.[/p][p]• Special Kicks now have much more recovery On Block.[/p][p]• Improvements to Capoeira's ground shadow to better reflect their movements.[/p][p]• Fixed a bug that prevented Scissor Grab from occurring when the Target is airborne.[/p][p]• Scissor Grab now tints gray after the whiffing the grab chance to better convey when you've missed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/915556643e2105c1dedbebff8e8a4af476df5b14.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Fixed a bug that caused Scissor Grab to be unbreakable even while the opponent wasn't Weakened.[/p][p]• Capoeira's Scissor Grab no longer places target into infinite NoTech.[/p][p]• Add new Feed Text "Decisive!" when Capoeira lands a Grab on a Weakened Target.[/p][p]• Capoeira's Trip Grab ("Vingativa") now properly deals Damage on the Throw Frame.[/p][p]• Capoeira's Scissor Grab and Trip Grab ("Vingativa") now properly places Target into NoTech for 3 seconds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/90ca30f9016e30871b6ee7283e70029f6c32340f.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Cartwheel Strike is now low profile on startup.[/p][p]• Fixed a hurtbox alignment bug during Cartwheel Strike's Recovery.[/p][p]• Cartwheel Strike can now be performed during the Neutral Stance portion of their BWDs Hop.[/p][p]• Cartwheel Strike previously lacked full support for Rhythm Strikes, this has been fixed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/aac7a46578667d044644a86d7f7664dc2643af77.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Add Feed Text "Bad!" when performing one of Capoeira's Special Kick from the wrong Stance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/0c2b73476790d88e86d862e3e30351dce52b00c6.gif"][/img][/p][p]• Reworked Front and Back Cartwheel's Hurtboxes to be more low profile and to better avoid Grabs.[/p][p]• Front and Back Cartwheels now add to their Ginga Steps.[/p][p]• Front and Back Cartwheels now more reliably avoid highs (and some mid Attacks).[/p][p]• Front and Back Cartwheels now recover faster when at Full Ginga.[/p][p]• Front and Back Cartwheels now startup much faster when performed from Neutral Stance.[/p][p]• Back Cartwheel's anti-air Hitbox range has been increased.[/p][p]• Back Cartwheel's travel distance now lessened when performed from a Back Stance with it even further lessened while in Full Ginga.[/p][p]• Removed 3 Capoeira infinites.[/p][p]• Added more appropriate Special Indicators for Capoeira in Training Mode to represent their Rhythm Strikes ♪[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/696ee933fe8730a9ed1dfed338e36ff7cdfd3182.gif"][/img][/p]

tags.balance_change: • Universally, we've gone through with a fine comb to improve the general readability of gameplay.
♦ Most interactions now cause much longer Hitstop (Even more-so on Counter-Hit).
♦ Input Buffers have been tweaked to help certain actions flow a bit more comfortably.
♦ More VFX, SE, and Feed Text have been added to various interactions to better convey what has occurred.
♦ Add pushboxes to most attacks and actions to better prevent awkward player overlapping that could make certain interactions hard to visually parse in some cases.
• Removed a Parry/Guard option-select performed by pressing [FWD]+[BWD] simultaneously:
♦ Parry now locks itself out for 3 Frames when pressing [BWD] in neutral.
♦ Parry now locks itself out for 7 Frames when pressing [BWD] while Parry Attempt is Active.
• Retooled Super Uppercut to be more fair and reliable to execute across all input types.
• Super Uppercut now has a "Perfect" variant which occurs when you execute the attack perfectly (Just Frame) with [FWD]+[Punch] pressed at the exact same time.
♦ This variant has different knockback properties and deals additional base and chip Damage.
• Power Strike now has a "Perfect" variant which occurs when you release the punch at the earliest possible point when reaching max charge.
♦ This variant has different knockback properties and deals additional base and chip Damage.

tags.bug: • Fixed a bug that allowed Kyokushin Karate to Block immediately after/while being Thrown.

tags.bug: • Fixed a bug that unintentionally gave Capoeira's Low Dodge an upper body Hurtbox when on the Left-Ginga.

tags.bug: • Fixed a bug that prevented Capoeira from Blocking after being Hurt.

tags.bug: • Fixed a bug that would cause Capoeira to briefly gain additional hurtboxes when attacks were interrupted.

tags.feature: • Improvements to Capoeira's ground shadow to better reflect their movements.

notes.title: Dojo Masters Expansion Pack (DLC)
notes.content: [h1]Dojo Masters Season 2![/h1][p]It's been a little over a year since Dojo Masters launched.  We've been busy behind the scenes cleaning things up, improving systems, prepping new content, and designing more ways to play.  We felt it was about time that we added something new.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]So, what's in Season 2?[/b][/h1][h2][b]❖ Martial Art Improvements![/b][/h2][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"][/img] Balance and System changes[/h3][p]All Martial Arts are being re-balanced to align with the content in the Season 2 update.  [/p][p]Additionally, we have been chipping away at some really niche bugs and oversights across the board to make things more consistent.[/p][p]Lastly, we have been experimenting with and tweaking various aspects from gameplay-flow, execution, readability, VFX, audio queues, and the like.  So expect things to feel slightly different once the update arrives.  And we will continue to make improvements as the updates continue to roll out.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]❖ Expansion Pack DLC![/b][/h2][previewyoutube="48ODBo5mTpQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h3] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"][/img] First up on the chopping block!![/h3][p][b]3 New Martial Arts[/b] will be joining the roster: [/p][h3][b]Sumo[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/ccbab2e1dc33f1c4abd368e6657463037263f7d9.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Kyokushin Karate[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/fee7087c1a1e592eb1b4ddf291f56cf22bde63a4.gif"][/img][/p][h3]and the highly requested [b]Capoeira[/b]![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/eeb1ad77f210042125552da7e5511a1c97de0aab.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"][/img] Next up on the chopping block!![/h3][p]The Expansion Pack also comes with [b]2 Exclusive Stages[/b]: [/p][h3]ARENA-3 \\\\The Sumo Stage[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5d773a540fe52e71945233e65facc33752802c1f.gif"][/img][/p][h3]SPORT-1 \\\\The Hockey Rink[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4ee3d687fb3607bc956d216f4a1c2f5f4ffa05a6.gif"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, the DLC pack comes with [b]3 new exclusive Martial Art music tracks[/b] from our amazing [url="https://twitter.com/cxldr3"]composer[/url].[/p][h3]This Expansion Pack is scheduled to drop on [b]August 21st[/b].[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807730/Dojo_Masters__Expansion_Pack_1/"][/dynamiclink][i](Dojo Masters: Expansion Pack (DLC) is paid DLC)[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]❖ Mission Mode[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/84f1cd2bec2e7853bcf809212bc988a1eea8504a.gif"][/img][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"][/img] Looking for a challenge?  [/h3][p]Mission Mode is a free new single-player game mode designed to challenge you in a variety of unique scenarios.  Aim for the Gold Trophies![/p][p]Season 2 will launch with 4 Missions.  With [b]new missions added every week[/b] (up until we run out of ideas).  We can't wait to show you what we've got cooking :P[/p][p][/p][h1]❖ An Updated Look[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/f78e5711ecb8c0b518ef7886ec8c7ff3d1be9383.gif"][/img][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"][/img] A fresh new look![/h3][p]Along with all of these new additions, we will also be updating Dojo Master's menu interface.  While it still isn't complete (A handful of menus still need to be converted), we felt that it would be a missed opportunity not to give you guys a taste of the new look when Season 2 drops.[/p][p][/p][h1]❖ New Stages[/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"][/img] 3 new Stages for a change of scenery[/h3][p]Season 2 will include 3 new generic stages to play on.  While these stages are primarily designed for the new [b]Mission Mode,[/b] they are also planned to be used in some future unannounced content...[/p][h3]ROOM-1[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/037a7ea47f9611b6e51ae762dcd2d820f0ae44c8.png"][/img][/p][h3]ROOM-2[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/cc024504a8969314992b467ecfe00b9f3ee19b9e.png"][/img][/p][h3]COURTYARD-1[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/0154988b26794dddc8414524f6e4ecdd288cb985.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]❖ Ranked Mode?[/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"][/img] Where Is Ranked?[/h3][p]While originally planned the Ranked mode update to be sometime shortly after launch, we ran into a lot of roadblocks that prevented us from releasing Dojo Masters' Ranked Mode in a fully functional state.  [/p][p]Unfortunately, we still need a little more time to work some things out.  We have a lot of playtesting to do before it is ready.  Once Season 2 releases we will be putting all of our effort into making Ranked our next top priority.  Ideally, we're targeting a month after, but we apologize for the further delay [b]🙏[/b][/p][p]With all of that said, at the very least, I would like to loosely detail how exactly Ranked will function once it releases.  Just to give you a small taste of what we're setting up.[/p][p]*[b]Reminder: Ranked Mode will be a free update. [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/8203f169b0f99ec1ff7e9f3a48ba317be4eea8ad.png"][/img][/p][p][i]*Mockup image for reference[/i][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/66aa3e96bfab52b84ffd67a52b02398d7c62cb3d.gif"][/img] How Will Ranked Work?[/h3][p]Ranks are determined by belts.  Every player starts off without one.  Once you've won your first match, you are rewarded a basic white belt and this belt can never be lost.  There are 20* unique belt ranks.[/p][p]Every Rank has an RP(Ranked Points) requirement to move up to the next belt.  The requirement increases as you climb.  Each Ranked Match will be a First-to-3 set.  Meaning, you can earn up to 3 RP per ranked match.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/7f5e146954340423b37c77a9bf781ada4c73f5b4.png"][/img][/p][p]Every round-win rewards you +1 RP, losing to a player of the same rank loses you -1 RP, but losing to a player of a lower Rank will drop your current belt rank by 1.  [b]However[/b], if you've lost your belt to a player of a lower rank, you can win the subsequent round(s) to boost yourself back up a belt, but now starting at the beginning of that rank's RP.[/p][p][b]Ranked Belts will be tied to the individual Martial Art[/b].  So you can begin the climb from a White Belt with a new Martial Art without fear of losing your progress with another.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/a91761dfedc970839a9421faa1411ba34cf93f3a.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, if you don't maintain your Ranked play for a long period of time, your Ranked Martial Arts will gradually begin depreciating in rank until they've returned down to a White Belt.[/p][p]*Ranked Mode details are subject to change.[/p][p][/p][h1]❖ What's Next?[/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/5b148ff9cfa06ac7f2d131dba45637fc40723508.gif"][/img] We hope to see you at Season 2's Launch![/h3][p]Around launch-time, we will be running a few community events, as well as laying out a roadmap of future content.  [b]So keep an eye out for more details![/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Also, [b]All previous Replay Data will be lost[/b] one the Season 2 patch drops due to incompatibility.[/p]

notes.title: Pre-Ranked Balance Patch (v1.0.9.0b)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/411b47b9d4c58e3fe6062b89136bc5c0a0b04fde.png[/img]
[h1]Pre-Ranked Balance Patch[/h1]
We are unfortunately a little behind schedule (Not just because of prepping for our recent showing at East Coast Throwdown, but our lead dev came down with the flu).  With that said, we think it would be best to at least push the most recent balance changes (and bug fixes) in preparation for Ranked.

We still need a little bit longer to get Ranked Mode up and ready, but as soon as we have additional details to share we will let you know!

[u][h1]Patchnotes[/h1][/u]
[h2]❖ System Changes ❖[/h2]
[list][*] Introduced a new [b]Pseudo-Hitstun[/b] and [b]Pseudo-Blockstun[/b] mechanic.[list][*] Acts similarly to normal stun states but doesn't interrupt your current action, and locks you out of performing actions.
[*] This was introduced to address an oversight in Krav Maga's Hit-Counters weren't interacting properly On Blocked.[/list][/list]
[h2]❖ Balance Changes ❖[/h2]
[h3][u]Shotokan Karate[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Crouch:[/b]
Re-Crouching now properly plays the correct Hurt Reaction.
Hitstun now properly carries over when hit while crouching.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/b3412a50a265cc63618cb5a2f10b2ac13222a516.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][u]Muay Thai[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Kick on whiffed Perfect Sweep:[/b]
 On Hit (-2 → -5)
 On Blocked (-28 → -33)
[*] [b]Forward Kick on whiffed Perfect Sweep:[/b]
 On Hit (-2 → -5)
 On Blocked (-20 → -25)
[*] [b]Knee:[/b]
 AI is now slightly less likely to spam the Knee.
[*] [b]Clinch:[/b]
 Recovery on Grab Broken increased (-14 → -25)
 Break window of Non-Perfect Sweeps increased  (1 → 6)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/07c0375ee833dee9e0fbf358a432e2a65dedfdb0.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][u]Kendo[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Counter Stance:[/b]
 No longer allowed to break Initial Grabs while in Stance.
[*] [b]Dash Counter Stance:[/b]
 No longer allowed to break Initial Grabs while in Stance.
 Getting Parried will now always allow you to be punished appropriately.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/d40e37fa34b8f1b06c9a18fc51fcf787518596d6.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][u]Taekwondo[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]High Kick:[/b]
 Less likely to hit targets standing behind them
[*] [b]Backward Feint:[/b]
 Readjusted Hurtbox to allow for slightly easier grab escapes.
[*] [b]Super Feint Forward Kick:[/b]
 Blockstun increased (8 → 17)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/102d98cd672f22221d7ba7527fc17424a070b7db.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][u]Boxing[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Uppercut:[/b]
 Updated Hitbox to be less likely to hit airborne targets on cross-up.
 Reduced upward knockback of Spindash Uppercut from (-3 → -2)
[*] [b]Spindash(Green):[/b]
 Activation Hitstop has been reduced (20 → 15)
[*] [b]SpinDash Uppercut:[/b]
 Hitstop against airborne targets reduced (20 → 15)
[*] [b]SpinDash Hook:[/b]
 Hitstop against airborne targets reduced (25 → 15)
[*] [b]SpinDash:[/b]
 All strong attacks now deal 50% less damage against airborne targets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/4afa6f7f07eebb9f2bd2d74fa0747b22abf1f0f4.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][u]Krav Maga[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Combat Roll:[/b]
 Blockstun increased (+8 → +16)
 Backwards Momentum is now completely killed upon use to prevent accidental stalling.
[*] [b]Hit-Counters:[/b]
 Both Punch and Kick Hit-Counters now deal 5 Frames of Pseudo-Blockstun.
 Getting Parried will now always allow you to be punished appropriately.
[*] [b]Total Takedown:[/b]
 Every consecutive Total Takedown that has been initiated will now decrease the amount of necessary guesses needed to confirm the Knockdown.[list][*] Will reset to 3 guesses on Round Reset.
[*] Number of guesses will never drop below 1.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44456438/3da348b6984ea9286071cfd846066abbf2ee3371.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]❖ Training Mode ❖[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the Training Dummy to perform Behavior Acts multiple times on Blockstun-Recovery.
[*] Fixed the "Grabbed" Behavior(While) state for the Training Dummy as it was treating Hitstun as being Grabbed.
[*] Resetting the Scene no longer clears the displayed info from the FrameData Timeline.
[/list]
[h2]❖ Netplay ❖[/h2]
[h3][u]Stability[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the illusive community named "Top" bug where you would get a connection error after certain network interactions after being in an online match for too long.
[*] Addressed a massive oversight in Hitbox/Hurtbox interactions that would eventually lead to desyncs across Online Matches.
[*] You can now properly pause the game during match transitions while playing online.
[*] Potentially fixed some edge-case netplay softlocks.
[/list][h3][u]Lobbies[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated default Custom Lobby settings to be
 [list][*] Room A: VS ∞ Matches
 [*] Room B: VS 10 Matches
 [*] Room C: VS 10 Matches
 [*] Room D: Training Mode[/list][*] New Lobby Welcome Message
[/list]
[h2]❖ Misc. ❖[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed some input related oversights where the game would register unassigned controllers.
[*] Addressed an a very rare oversight that would prevent a character from interacting with a Hurtbox that they have previously interacted with.
[*] Players will no longer interact with the Pushbox of the a Player that they are grabbing.
  [list][*] This was adversely affecting Muay Thai's Clinch Grab Pummel interactions.[/list][*] Added a delay when pressing the {B} button at the results screen so that you're less likely to accidentally quit a match due to mashing.
[*] Stage Change Button at Results Screen (As well as for Spectators) now always randomizes on the first click, and cycles in order on repeated presses.
[*] Fixed an unexpected graphical image involving after images on certain stages.[list][*] Ex. ARENA-1's screen projector[/list][*] Changed the text "SETTINGS" for the ONLINE Menu to "CONFIG".
[*] Fixed a minor visual bug involving Grab Indicators for P3 and P4 in Free-For-All.
[*] Minor improvements to Arabic localization in the Activity Feed.
[*] Potentially fixed a bug that would cause a text entry field to linger on screen.
[*] Minor improvements to character select box ordering/positioning.
[/list]
[h2]❖ Workshop ❖[/h2]
[list]
[*] Doodle Chan has been updated to fix a few graphical issues.
[*] Potentially fixed a bug that could cause the wrong Workshop Mods to show up in the wrong Manage Menus.
[*] Editor has been updated to DX11 to prevent graphical crashes.
[*] Fixed multiple UX issues with the Editor.
[*] Updated the Frame Data Timeline to display GoTo tooltips if pointing to the same Sequence.
[/list]

notes.title: Addressing and Tackling Launch Bugs
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/h4QdnCLV/Dojo-Masters-Pixel-Banner.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hello,[/b][/h3]
We are making this post to draw attention to some common bugs that we are currently working on, are currently investigating, as well as a few features we plan on getting in a soon a possible:

[h2]In Progress[/h2]
[list]
[*] More improvements to Matchmaking.
[*] Players getting matched against those who haven't updated their game client, and thus are unable to begin the match.
[*] Controls getting locked while in the Tutorial.
[*] Skins sometimes not showing up for opponents while playing.
[*] Adjustment to Survival Mode CPU to prevent them from hugging the edges of the screen as often as they do.
[*] Side Preference Match Settings are causing Loading Screen Text to flip.
[/list]

[h2]Investigating[/h2]
[list]
[*] Character's not fully loading when entering a match (Causing characters to be completely invisible)
[*] Horrible frame drops after failing to connect to a match.
[*] Online Survival Mode is desyncing at the start of the match.
[*] General low framerates on the Steam Deck.
[*] Getting stuck on the BGM Loading Step when launching the game.
[*] Some BGM Tracks failing to initialize properly and thus causing it to constantly restart the intro.
[/list]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ability to instantly retry Arcade Mode after a Game Over.
[*] Further adjustments to Tutorials and Trials to better convey certain aspects that may confuse a few players (As well as demonstrations)
[*] In-game access to the game's workshop tools (Waiting on a response from Valve in order to fix this issue).
[/list]


We're trying our best to address as many as possible, as soon as possible, with almost all of our current efforts being focused on addressing matchmaking/match loading bugs.  Many unexpected things broke on launch, but we appreciate your patience as we try and tackle everything.  Expect multiple updates/patches throughout the next few days!

Thanks,
Pixeled Vision
